title: Moving-muon semi-Compton local rates on reconstructed SFHo-18.8 profile
scope: Local-frame muon-photon Compton production and absorption only. No neutrino or dimuon channels, radial integration, optical depth, transport, luminosity, or exclusion curve.
background_identity: Reconstructed SFHo-18.8, t_pb=1 s digitized profile; not original simulation tables and not an exact Blinov Fig. 7 background.

coupling_convention.normalization: All rates are coefficients multiplying g_X^2
coupling_convention.note: Neutrino couplings are recorded for model bookkeeping; neutrino rates are not included in this Compton-only output.
